scripts.type-check: cd client && npx tsc -b && cd ../server && npm run type-check
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx supabase db reset --workdir .. --local --no-seed
scripts.db:test: cd server && SUPABASE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true DO_NOT_TRACK=1 CI=true npx supabase test db --workdir .. --local ../supabase/tests/database_integrity.test.sql
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "cd server && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
